_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Hovering the record button offers Voice & Screen with a single screen request. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". "The record menu" is [data-testid="record-menu"]. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. No record menu may exist (count 0).
2. Hover the voice button. The record menu should become visible.
3. Exactly 2 buttons ('[data-testid="record-menu"] button') should be in it. The first's accessible name (its aria-label) should be exactly "Voice", and the last's exactly "Voice & Screen".
Moving away closes it.
4. Hover [data-testid="attach-button"]. No record menu should remain (count 0).
5. Hover the voice button, then click the record menu's button "Voice & Screen" ('[data-testid="record-menu"] button[aria-label="Voice & Screen"]').
6. The recording panel should get data-mode "screen", and [data-testid="recording-status"] should have the text exactly "Recording screen + microphone…".
7. Eval "JSON.stringify((m => ({display: m.displayRequests, synchronous: m.synchronousDisplayRequests, microphone: m.microphoneRequests}))(window.__recordingMock))" must return exactly {"display":1,"synchronous":1,"microphone":1}.
